name: Binary baseline adder and multiplier units
purpose: Two's complement add and multiply units at 32 and 64 bits, generated beside the representation units so every hardware figure has its binary baseline (NUM-06).
interfaces: Combinational ports a, b, r of w bits per unit
enablement: Synthesisable SystemVerilog and VHDL-2008 units regenerated from a specification with one command
A cocotb testbench that reads plain-text conformance vectors and runs on Verilator and GHDL
Open FPGA synthesis and timing figures (Yosys, nextpnr-ice40) recorded with tool versions as measurements

evidence.rtl: hmnsq/repsynth gen/hdl/units/binary_integer/sv and gen/hdl/units/binary_integer/vhdl (generated by repsynth.gen.hdl 0.3.0)
evidence.testbench: hmnsq/repsynth conformance/runners/hdl/test_unit.py on Verilator and GHDL over the shared vectors; record records/20261104T233642Z_P5.3_sim.json

open_questions: Which multiplier architecture the baseline should fix for 28 nm comparisons (array, Booth or DSP-mapped)
